blowout.label: The Blowout
blowout.description: Largest margin of victory in a single matchup this week.

projection_buster.label: Projection Buster
projection_buster.description: Biggest single-player overperformance vs. their projection.

waiver_hero.label: Waiver Hero
waiver_hero.description: Best-scoring starter picked up off waivers or free agency in the last two weeks.

mvp.label: Week MVP
mvp.description: Highest single-player win-probability-added performance this week.

nail_biter.label: Nail-biter
nail_biter.description: Smallest margin of victory in a single matchup this week.

luckiest.label: Luckiest Win
luckiest.description: Won this week despite scoring below the week's median.

unluckiest.label: Hard-luck Loser
unluckiest.description: Lost this week despite scoring above the week's median.

bust.label: The Bust
bust.description: Biggest single-player underperformance vs. their projection (min. 10 projected points).

lvp.label: Week LVP
lvp.description: Lowest single-player win-probability-added performance this week.

worst_benching.label: Worst Benching
worst_benching.description: Largest-scoring benched player who outscored a starter eligible for their slot.

lowest_score.label: Lowest Score
lowest_score.description: Fewest points scored by any team this week.
